hotspots.title: Midterm Campaign Blitz
hotspots.blurb: Trump and top GOP figures criss‑cross swing states for rallies, stumping events and high‑visibility visits as the midterm elections approach, energizing the base while drawing fierce criticism from opponents.
hotspots.affect: The relentless rally schedule is framed as a showdown for control of Congress, sparking outrage and triumph language across right‑wing outlets.

hotspots.title: Immigration Enforcement Legal Battles
hotspots.blurb: A wave of lawsuits and Supreme Court actions targets the Trump administration’s hard‑line immigration policies, from mandatory detention reviews to third‑country deportations and an ICE shooting lawsuit.
hotspots.affect: Coverage emphasizes victim grievances, alleged illegal government overreach, and a looming judicial showdown, inflaming anger and fear among supporters and opponents alike.

hotspots.title: Trump AI Self‑Regulation Push
hotspots.blurb: The administration promotes voluntary AI safeguards, launches an AI‑powered America.gov site, and touts a new chatbot that even contradicts Trump’s own claims, while critics decry the lack of oversight.
hotspots.affect: The narrative pits tech elites against government control, using charged language about “self‑policing” and “dangerous AI,” driving heated debate.

hotspots.title: Economic Policy Rollbacks & Funding Cuts
hotspots.blurb: Trump’s team cancels $810 million in refugee services, rolls back fuel‑economy standards, issues Obamacare refunds, slashes oil‑reserve releases, and opens a student‑loan support center, sparking criticism over fiscal priorities.
hotspots.affect: The cluster is portrayed as reckless attacks on public welfare and environmental standards, provoking alarm and moral outrage.

hotspots.title: Public‑Money Propaganda Ads Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Democrats allege the Trump administration illegally used taxpayer funds for pre‑election ads promoting the president, a claim echoed in multiple outlets as a scandal of government propaganda.
hotspots.affect: The story is framed as an abuse of public money for partisan gain, igniting accusations of corruption and betrayal of public trust.
